en-US.title: LightCyclesTastic
en-US.subtitle: Light Cycle Duels. No Ads.
en-US.description:
A fast arcade duel for two players on one phone, or one player against the CPU. Every rider leaves a solid trail behind them, and the last cycle still riding wins. No ads, no accounts.

• Two players face to face, each steering in their own half of the screen
• Play the CPU at three difficulties
• Five arenas: Open, Pillars, Gauntlet, Portals, and Underpass
• Six optional powerups, including Shield, Stasis, and Overdrive
• Three grid sizes, three speeds, and Wrap Edges
• Player profiles, stats, and 30 achievements
• Plays offline

Part of the Tastic family of games. Your player profiles are shared with the other Tastic games on your device.

Open source on GitHub: https://github.com/jayrdeaton/LightCycles
